instruction: Stand the blue pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

# Observe current scene
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["blue_pen"]
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Get candidates and pick one that grasps the pen across its width
candidates = grasp_candidates("blue_pen")
# Prefer candidate with squeeze_width matching short axis / footprint_short
chosen_candidate = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c["squeeze_width"] - pen["footprint_short"]))

# Grasp the pen
grasp(chosen_candidate)

# Carry above the holder, clearing the rim height
rim_height = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)
safe_height = rim_height + 0.15
carry_to(holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1], height=safe_height)

# Orient gripper to tilt pen vertical or lower into cup
# A pen held across fingers points along 'side' = approach x finger_axis.
# To make it upright, we can pitch the gripper so 'side' or 'approach' aligns pen vertically,
# or simply lower and drop into the cup.
# Let's lower down into the cup carefully:
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("blue_pen", "magenta_holder")

obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, _ = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.089)

# Note: In the current scene, blue_pen was placed horizontally across the holder rim,
# and is visible as an object (or we can grasp it again). Check objects:
obj_name = "blue_pen" if "blue_pen" in obs["objects"] else list(obs["objects"].keys())[0]

candidates = grasp_candidates(obj_name)
chosen = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c["squeeze_width"] - 0.012))
grasp(chosen)

# The pen is held horizontally across the gripper fingers.
# Gripper coordinate frame:
# approach = [0, 0, -1] (pointing down)
# finger_axis = finger direction (closes along finger_axis)
# side = approach x finger_axis (long axis of the pen lies along side).
# To make the pen upright (vertical, along z):
# 'side' must point along [0, 0, -1] or [0, 0, 1].
# side = approach x finger_axis.
# If approach = [1, 0, 0] (horizontal forward) and finger_axis = [0, 1, 0] (horizontal left),
# then side = [1, 0, 0] x [0, 1, 0] = [0, 0, 1] (vertical!).
# Thus the pen becomes vertical.

# First lift up above holder
target_z = table_z + rim_h + 0.16
move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="line")

# Lower the vertically oriented pen into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.10)
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("blue_pen", "magenta_holder")
